finding.explanation: The commit made the benchmark slower because it introduced a change that reduces the diversity of reverse links. The previous code was appending new nodes to the end of the list of links for each neighbor, which could lead to a decrease in the diversity of the links. The new code changes the condition to only append new nodes if the length of the list exceeds 1, which ensures that the links remain diverse. This change should improve the performance of the benchmark.
